caveat: Computed by the real metrics pipeline, but from the synthetic scaffold table, not from store footage. Structure is real; the numbers are not.

tile_insights.footfall: Trade is concentrated rather than spread evenly, and 19:00 is the crest of it. Roster against the shape of the day rather than against the daily total, which hides the peak entirely.
tile_insights.fullest_moment: The shop was at its fullest around 19:15. This is the number that decides how it feels to walk into -- if the counter is short-handed at that moment, nothing else on this page matters as much.
tile_insights.typical_stop: Time in one section, not time in the shop -- a visit is several of these end to end. Trials runs well above the rest, and a long stop is where a question turns into a sale.
